correctness.rationale: The stated cone event follows from restricting the diagonal quadratic form diag(a^-2,b^-2,c^-2) to N-perp and applying weighted Cauchy-Schwarz. Haar latitude is uniform; integrating its cone threshold yields the precise interior CDF. Dominated convergence yields the square-root upper-tail coefficient, and strict derivative of the complete elliptic integral on (0,1) proves unique recovery of the third axis after the support endpoints determine the two largest. Independently recomputed for axes (3,2,1): F(2.5)=0.550111203752269 and T=0.53370587242544; numeric checks are corroboration, not an infinite proof.
